en.title: Indirect questions
en.summary: An indirect question is a question inside another sentence, with statement word order.

paragraphs: An indirect question is a question inside another sentence. It sounds more polite than a direct question, and it is used after expressions such as Do you know, Can you tell me and I wonder. It is very useful for asking strangers for information.

items: Can you tell me **how much it costs**?

paragraphs: In an indirect question the word order is the same as in a statement: no inversion and no do. If there is no question word, use if or whether. The verb is in the same tense as in a statement. The question mark goes only after a direct opening, such as Do you know.

blocks.html:
DirectIndirect
Where is the bank?Do you know where the bank is?
Does he know?I wonder if he knows.
What time is it?Can you tell me what time it is?
Why did she leave?I don't know why she left.
Is he at home?I asked whether he was at home.

paragraphs: The same pattern is used in reported speech. The direct question Where do you live? becomes She asked where I lived. The tense moves back one step and the word order is that of a statement.
Indirect questions soften a request. Compare Where is the station? with Could you tell me where the station is? The second is more polite, especially to a stranger.

items: Wrong: **Do you know where is the bank?** Right: **Do you know where the bank is?**
Wrong: **I wonder what does he want.** Right: **I wonder what he wants.**
Wrong: **She asked did I know.** Right: **She asked if I knew.**

ro.title: Întrebări indirecte
ro.summary: O întrebare indirectă este o întrebare inclusă într-o altă propoziție, adesea pentru a fi mai politicoasă.

paragraphs: O întrebare indirectă se află în interiorul altei propoziții. Ea este o formă mai politicoasă de a cere informații. O folosim des când vorbim cu persoane necunoscute.

În limba română, ordinea cuvintelor nu se schimbă într-o întrebare indirectă. Dacă întrebarea directă nu are un cuvânt interogativ, adăugăm cuvântul „dacă”. La final punem punct sau semnul întrebării, după caz.

blocks.html:
Întrebare directăÎntrebare indirectă
Unde este gara?Știi unde este gara?
Cât costă pâinea?Vreau să știu cât costă pâinea.
Vine Maria azi?Nu știu dacă vine Maria azi.
Ce oră este?Poți să-mi spui ce oră este?
